monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC 2026 May Day Holiday Schedule JLCCNC 2026 May Day Holiday Schedule Press Release Apr 24, 2026 Table of Contents Production & Delivery Notes: JLCCNC factories will observe a 3-day holiday from May 1 to May 3, 2026 . Please note that while our production lines take a brief break, you can still place orders online, and our customer service will remain available. Production & Delivery Notes: Production Lead Time : For CNC Machining, PCB, PCBA, Stencil, and 3D Printing orders placed after 6:00 PM (GMT+8) on April 30th , production will officially commence on May 4th . In-stock Parts Service : This service remains unaffected . In-stock parts will be added to your personal library immediately after checkout as usual. Delivery Schedule : Please anticipate a corresponding adjustment/postponement in delivery dates due to the holiday period. JLCCNC Holiday Schedule Logistics companies Schedule Thank you for your understanding and continued support!
